source.title: Job Hunting Is a Data Problem. I Treated It Like One.

title: I Turned My Job Search Into a Pipeline
subtitle: Deterministic data modeling beats guesswork job hunting
supportLine: Models coordinate. Tools do the work.
palette: midnight navy and deep teal base with warm amber and electric cyan data-flow accents
visualConcept: Abstract data pipeline flowing left to right: scattered glowing data rows funnel into a clean structured grid of tables, converging on one glowing toggle switch symbolizing the single point of judgment. Flat geometric tech illustration, soft glow, no screens or logos.
style: modern editorial tech illustration, flat vector shapes with subtle gradients and soft glow, clean geometric data motifs, no photorealism, no literal UI screenshots
